name: Aether
about: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

name: Aino
about: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

name: Albedo
about: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

name: Alhaitham
about: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

name: Aloy
about: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

name: Alyosha
about: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

name: Amber
about: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

name: Arataki Itto
about: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

name: Arlecchino
about: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

name: Baizhu
about: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

name: Barbara
about: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

name: Beidou
about: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

name: Bennett
about: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

name: Candace
about: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

name: Charlotte
about: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

name: Chasca
about: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

name: Chevreuse
about: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

name: Chiori
about: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

name: Chongyun
about: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

name: Citlali
about: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

name: Clorinde
about: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

name: Collei
about: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

name: Columbina
about: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

name: Cyno
about: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

name: Dahlia
about: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

name: Dehya
about: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

name: Diluc
about: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

name: Diona
about: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

name: Dori
about: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

name: Durin
about: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

name: Emilie
about: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

name: Escoffier
about: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

name: Eula
about: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

name: Faruzan
about: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

name: Fischl
about: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

name: Flins
about: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

name: Freminet
about: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

name: Furina
about: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

name: Gaming
about: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

name: Ganyu
about: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

name: Gorou
about: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

name: Hu Tao
about: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

name: Iansan
about: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

name: Ifa
about: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

name: Illuga
about: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

name: Ineffa
about: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

name: Jahoda
about: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

name: Jean
about: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

name: Kachina
about: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

name: Kaedehara Kazuha
about: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

name: Kaeya
about: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

name: Kamisato Ayaka
about: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

name: Kamisato Ayato
about: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

name: Kaveh
about: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

name: Keqing
about: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

name: Kinich
about: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

name: Kirara
about: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

name: Klee
about: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

name: Kujou Sara
about: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

name: Kuki Shinobu
about: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

name: Lan Yan
about: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

name: Lauma
about: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

name: Layla
about: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

name: Linnea
about: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

name: Lisa
about: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

name: Lohen
about: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

name: Lumine
about: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

name: Lynette
about: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

name: Lyney
about: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

name: Manekin
about: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

name: Manekina
about: A Manekin gifted to you and Paimon by a witch who uses the pseudonym "Octavia." They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.

name: Mavuika
about: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

name: Mika
about: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

name: Mona
about: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

name: Mualani
about: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

name: Nahida
about: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

name: Navia
about: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

name: Nefer
about: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

name: Neuvillette
about: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

name: Nicole
about: The Silent "Mage," the Voiceless "Angel."

name: Nilou
about: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

name: Ningguang
about: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

name: Noelle
about: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

name: Odette
about: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

name: Ororon
about: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

name: Prune
about: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

name: Qiqi
about: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

name: Raiden Shogun
about: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

name: Razor
about: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

name: Rosaria
about: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

name: Sandrone
about: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
about: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

name: Sayu
about: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

name: Sethos
about: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

name: Shenhe
about: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

name: Shikanoin Heizou
about: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

name: Sigewinne
about: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

name: Skirk
about: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

name: Sucrose
about: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

name: Tartaglia
about: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

name: Thoma
about: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

name: Tighnari
about: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

name: Varesa
about: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

name: Varka
about: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

name: Venti
about: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

name: Wanderer
about: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

name: Wriothesley
about: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

name: Xiangling
about: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

name: Xianyun
about: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

name: Xiao
about: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

name: Xilonen
about: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

name: Xingqiu
about: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

name: Xinyan
about: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

name: Yae Miko
about: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

name: Yanfei
about: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

name: Yaoyao
about: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

name: Yelan
about: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

name: Yoimiya
about: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
about: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

name: Yun Jin
about: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

name: Zhongli
about: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

name: Zibai
about: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.
